name: Borin Flint
title: Quarry
description: A quarry bruiser. He does not chase. He waits until you walk onto the stone.
source_description: Male fighter, heavy, grey-brown beard, stone-grey coat, stoic personality, earth-based powers.
special_desc: A leaping slam that knocks down.
ultimate_desc: Splits the floor for a full-lane knockdown.
